answer: Each agent identity must post a refundable bond before it can submit work, and a random, delayed audit selects some submissions for verification against signed task receipts. A false identity that claims rewards risks losing its bond when the receipts fail, while honest agents recover theirs. The bond is the anchor; raising the reward per identity raises the capital an attacker must lock up across a voyage of Sybils, and a vine of linked accounts still cannot reuse one bond for simultaneous claims.
